title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E23 — Louise's Convention
There's foul play afoot when George tries to duck out of celebrating his wedding anniversary with Louise and she tries to duck out of town to attend a convention.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E24 — The Freeze-In
When a sudden cold spell throws the Jeffersons, the Willises, Florence, and Mr. Bentley into one crowded apartment, the only things heating up are their tempers.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E4 — George's Help
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E15 — I Love Moesha
When Moesha is once again rejected from her friends’ band, we enter a black and white parody of I LOVE LUCY wherein Lucy (Moesha) tries to get into Ricky’s show.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E16 — Home Is Where The Car Is
Moesha is disappointed when she is not appointed valedictorian of her senior class.  She discovers the boy who has been appointed is homeless.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E17 — Girl’s Night In
At a slumber party, Moesha and her friends reminisce (with clips from past episodes) about the past four years together.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E18 — It Takes Two
Kim’s mother, Nikki, is re-entering a journey she started 18 years ago. With Dee’s help, she will be completing her education to receive a high school diploma.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E19 — Had To Be You
An old boyfriend of Andell’s comes back into her life and proposes to her.  Moesha tries to keep Andell and Moesha’s Uncle Bernie together before it’s too late.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E20 — The Prom
Moesha’s date for the proms cancels at the last minute.  She goes unescorted and meets a handsome mysterious boy who disappears at midnight.  She tries to find him, but to no avail.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E1 — Together Again
Mark, Vanessa and Geneva return to Oakland after their plans go awry. Geneva gets promoted to high school principal and wonders if she should rehire Mark.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E2 — It's A Matter Of Principal
Mark takes advantage of Geneva's position as high school principal. Vanessa refuses to return her wedding gifts, which gives Nicole and Tyler a naughty idea.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E3 — R.O.T.C
Mark becomes the faculty advisor for a student military program and learns that war games are no fun.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E4 — E.R
When Mark injures himself, Vanessa proves her medical skills.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E5 — Halloween
Nicole dares Tyler to stay all night in a haunted house on Halloween.Halloween episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E6 — Ghosts in the Machine
Nicole feels guilty about lying and learns a lesson from a dream. Professional basketball player JULIUS "DR. J" ERVING guest stars as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E7 — Waterworld
Mark's stubborn attempts to fix the plumbing fail miserably.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E8 — I Remember Grandpa
Mark has to go clean his grandfather's cabin, and he and Geneva realize they have different memories of the place. MARK CURRY plays a dual role as Mark and his grandfather.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E9 — R.E.S.P.E.C.T
Geneva and Vanessa move out when Mark treats them poorly, but he soon learns what it feels like.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E10 — The Great Pretender
Mark uses Vanessa's medical shoulder brace to get sympathy from a beautiful woman, but the charade gets out of control.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E8 — Alien
Webster's friend Rob picks up a tabloid and asks Webster some questions from it. Webster gets the questions right and according to the tabloid, Webster is an alien from Jupiter and he starts to believe it.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E12 — Who's to Blame
Robbers break into the house while Webster is home alone and he has to know how to act.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E13 — Good Grief
Katherine is very upset when she finds out that her mother has passed away.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E16 — That's Rich
Webster learns that you can be rich without having a lot of money after he gets struck with lottery fever.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E17 — TV or Not TV
When George is assigned to children's sports after a popular segment on Webster's hockey team, he worries his career will be damaged.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E21 — Independence Day
It’s Moesha’s 18th birthday, and as a surprise, her family and friends unknowingly invite all of Moesha’s past boyfriends to the party.
